name: hashmap
algorithm: Hash map churn with each language's standard map and its default hash, u64 keys: n splitmix64-mixed keys inserted into a map that grows from empty, each looked up once with a hit and once with a miss, every other key removed, all n looked up again; rounds times with a fresh map (README.md; the std-hash lane's maphash task).

skip.c: no std hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own map; the checksum (every value found, every miss, every key left) checks that every map held the same keys
notes: Hashes and DoS posture (B20): mk Map.New, DD-5's fast fixed hash, public key; mk-keyed Map.NewKeyed, SipHash-1-3 under a random per-process key; Rust HashMap, SipHash-1-3 under RandomState's random key; Zig AutoHashMap, wyhash-based autoHash with seed 0, fixed; Go map, AES-based runtime hash seeded per map; C# Dictionary<ulong, ulong>, default ulong.GetHashCode() (XOR-folded 64-to-32-bit, fixed/unkeyed).
The same task as tests/bench-lanes/std-hash/maphash, with the checksums that lane recorded; this row adds the mk-keyed column B20 asks for.
